core_obligations: Descend: for alpha in F algebraic over E, take S to be the finite set of coefficients of a polynomial in E[x] satisfied by alpha; then alpha is algebraic over k(S) and k(S, alpha)/k(S) is finite
k(S)/k is finite by lemma-algebraic-finitely-generated (S finite and k(S)/k algebraic), so k(S, alpha)/k is finite by multiplicativity, whence alpha is algebraic over k
proof_roadmap: Reduce alpha's algebraicity to a finitely generated subextension via the coefficient set
Conclude finiteness of the tower and algebraicity over k
